text:
dylan: Quick ask — noticed a p99 bump on L40S from the prompt-batch sweep overnight. Logs look like short microbursts at tokens ~2-5, not steady growth. anyone else seeing this?

emma: I saw a couple runs with weird tail spikes. did we flip any batch or kernel selector flags recently?

dylan: No config commits AFAIK. CI run id is run-7678, snippet below for quick context:
```
.../bench/run-7678.log: INFO kernel=auto selected fast_attn_v2
.../bench/run-7678.log: WARN fallback to generic_kernel at token 3
...
```

bench-bot: sweep finished: artifact available at https://bench-storage.internal/artefacts/7678 (l40s+a100+h100 batch sweep)

sophia: can you paste the p99 numbers? my quick scan shows L40S p50 fine but p99 ~+40ms vs a100.

dylan: numbers from run-7678: p50 ~12.1ms all; p99: L40S 128ms, A100 85ms, H100 92ms. CPU scheduler spikes align with NVLINK fallback lines in the log.

raj: @emma can you try forcing the kernel hint on one L40S node? quick command:
```
export KERNEL_HINT=prefer_fast_attn
./bench --model=llama2-13b --batch=8 --seq=1024 --run-id=7681
```

emma: starting on l40s-12 now (node pool: l40s-12). ETA ~45m. will post results.

emma: update: run 7681 finished. p99 dropped to 95ms after applying the hint. grep of kernel lines: 
```
run-7681.log: kernel=fast_attn_v2 chosen
run-7681.log: no fallback observed
```

dylan: Great. Proposed next steps: 1) run an A/B across 3 nodes with/without the hint to confirm; 2) add kernel-selection telemetry so we can correlate decisions to latencies. raj can you own (1)? sophia own (2)?

raj: taking (1). scheduling 3 parallel jobs now (l40s-12/13/14). will aggregate and post numbers when complete.

sophia: adding telemetry. I’ll add a tiny envelope that logs selector inputs + chosen kernel id (low-overhead). Also pinging infra for driver/patch matrix: @infra-bot can you attach driver versions for nodes used?

infra-bot: nodes summary:
- l40s-12: driver=525.85, cuda=12.2
- l40s-13: driver=525.85, cuda=12.2
- l40s-14: driver=525.85, cuda=12.2
- a100-07: driver=530.41, cuda=12.3
- h100-03: driver=530.41, cuda=12.3

dylan: thanks. also quick PR ping: PR #3145 updates the bench runner to expose KERNEL_HINT env + tests. @emma @raj please review when you have a sec.

emma: :eyes: will review after current runs complete.

raj: reviewing now — small nit about test coverage for the env var, otherwise LGTM.

dylan: :thumbsup: let's keep this async unless the AB shows regressions persist. if p99 still stays elevated after telemetry + AB we'll open an incident and assign oncall.

emma: noted. I’ll also run a couple long-context prompts to ensure no regression at seq >2048.

raj: will post aggregated p50/p90/p99 table once jobs finish.

sophia: telemetry PR up shortly. linking here when ready.

dylan: thanks team — appreciate the quick triage.
